metadata.cache: OS page cache is not evicted; each round uses a fresh temporary directory; setup precedes measurement

durability.none: unbuffered engine writes without fsync; SQLite WAL synchronous=OFF
durability.fsync: engine os.fsync per transaction; SQLite WAL synchronous=FULL; no power-loss experiment
durability.compaction: both stores opened with sync=fsync for durable publication

metadata.io_counters: engine transfer bytes/decoded records, not device IO; SQLite low-level counters unavailable
metadata.statistics: latency p50/p95: pooled individual transaction samples, nearest-rank p95; round elapsed/throughput: median and p95 of independent measured rounds
metadata.execution: single process, randomized case/implementation order within each round; one full warmup round excluded
